observations.player: James Tedesco / Daly Cherry-Evans / Victor Radley / Angus Crichton / senior cohort
observations.observation: The Roosters are set to restore a large senior cohort rested in Round 27, including James Tedesco, Daly Cherry-Evans and Victor Radley. Angus Crichton remains a selection possibility rather than verified. Sam Walker remains unlikely before a potential preliminary final. At the official Finals launch, Tedesco identified the Roosters' Round 24 win over Penrith as their template: completion, field position, Daly Cherry-Evans controlling the game with his kicking, then attacking rather than playing too safely.
observations.decision_effect: Strengthened evidence-supported Roosters counter-case and matchup memory. Round 27 remains heavily down-weighted because of deliberate rest; Round 24 provides a more representative structural matchup reference.
observations.tip_effect: Panthers retained at 73%; no confidence chase.
